patterns.note: A two-column layout where the left column serves as a fixed, persistent navigation menu, and the right column contains all the scrollable content.
Extreme typographic hierarchy featuring massive, wide, bold sans-serif display headings contrasted sharply with small, tightly-spaced monospaced body text.
A strictly monochromatic black and white color scheme, used consistently for all text and backgrounds without any accent colors.
The left navigation column remains statically positioned in the viewport while the right content column scrolls independently beneath it.
Content sections are clearly delineated by thick, full-width horizontal rules and oversized, distinct headings, creating a strong visual separation.

technique_notes: To rebuild the layout, implement a fixed-position left sidebar that occupies a significant portion of the viewport width, while the main content area on the right is set to scroll independently.
Achieve the stark typographic contrast by using a very large, bold, and wide sans-serif font for all primary headings and a much smaller, monospaced font for all body and descriptive text.
The site's visual identity is built entirely on a high-contrast black and white palette, with no intermediate grays or accent colors.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings (often 5-10x body text size) with small, tightly-spaced monospaced body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the left navigation and around large headings, creating significant negative space, while body text has tight line-height.

standout: The site's design is exceptionally distinctive due to its brutalist-inspired, high-contrast typography, where monumental, wide sans-serif headings dominate the visual field, creating an almost architectural feel. This is starkly contrasted with minimal, monospaced body text and a rigid black-and-white palette, making the content feel less like a website and more like a dynamic, interactive poster or art piece.
